rawContent: In an interview with chef Irene Li last month, chef Ming Tsai made a joke about roofies and appeared dismissive of #MeToo reckonings. What came after was disappointment and an apology, as well as important questions about cancel culture vs. accountability. https://t.co/TkItiykxLy
